title: Ten Thousand in Congo

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm, heaviest in Africa: Ebola passes 10,000 in DR Congo, gunmen kill 62 in Nigeria, Sudan faces famine, Cyclone Arnab hits India. But the Syria-Jordan border reopens, Amazon acres are saved, and a drill-free cavity cure nears approval.

lines: Ten thousand now in Congo's fever,
thirty flags sign a famine warning,
and Arnab brings the river down.
Israel counts and no one's winning,
the Jordan gate swings open wide,
the markets climb on talk of circuits,
the Amazon kept on one side.
Keep your head down, keep it steady,
a quiet day is not a calm,
somewhere a tooth gets mended gently,
somewhere a hand lifts off the harm.
